description: Brazo de control para ESM3 guided generation. 300 secuencias: 100 shuffled (misma composición), 100 uniform (aleatoria), 100 mutated (70% identidad).

shuffled.description: Same amino acid composition as OPRM1, random shuffle
shuffled.falsification_value: If ESM3 variants do NOT have higher pathway enrichment than shuffled controls, ESM3 adds no value

uniform.description: Random sequence with uniform amino acid distribution, same length

mutated_70pct.description: 100 point-mutants of P35372 at exactly 70.00% identity (120/400 positions substituted, uniform draw over the 20 amino acids). Composition is NOT preserved: mean L1 deviation = 71.1. CORRECTED — the previous description claimed 'same composition', which @CRITICO measured as false.
mutated_70pct.falsification_value: If ESM3 variants at 70-90% identity are not better than random 70% mutants, ESM3 does not improve over random mutagenesis

mutated_70pct_compmatched.description: 100 point-mutants of P35372 at exactly 70.00% identity (120/400 positions), built by deranging the residues among the substituted positions. Amino-acid composition preserved EXACTLY (L1 = 0), Hamming distance identical to mutated_70pct.
mutated_70pct_compmatched.falsification_value: Deconvolutes composition from position. If ESM3 beats mutated_70pct but NOT this arm, its advantage was compositional, not structural.
mutated_70pct_compmatched.construction: derangement of the substituted-residue multiset; seed 20260824
